name: mori-matcha
description: Production cafe website: cart-based ordering, admin dashboard, live Google Reviews and an event Party Cart. React + Vite, Vercel serverless functions, Neon Postgres

paragraphs: A production website for a real matcha café: a cart-based ordering flow, an admin dashboard for incoming orders and per-drink availability, live Google Reviews, an event Party Cart page with a booking-inquiry builder, and full SEO/PWA setup. React + Vite on the front, Vercel serverless functions and a Postgres (Neon) database behind it.
Live: mori-matcha-inky.vercel.app — deployed and actually in use, not a demo. Demo video on my portfolio · built by Dondie Godwin Gatan

Try it in a minute (no account needed): open the menu, tap a drink, pick a sugar level and milk, add it to the cart, and open the cart. Then visit /party-cart and build an event inquiry. Nothing is sent unless you press the Instagram button, so it is safe to click around.
features: Cart-based ordering with a built-in "How ordering works" guide. Orders are written to a Postgres order log
through a serverless function, with rate limiting on submission and an order number the customer pastes into Instagram to confirm.
Admin dashboard at /admin (protected by an admin key): order status management, CSV export, and a
recoverable trash bin (deleted orders are soft-deleted with a deletedat stamp, so they can be restored).
